author: chago5
body:
Well I know most of you guys hate these kind of posts but, im Leaving Avicus. The reasons im leaving is 1) avicus isnt that fun anymore.. They need to add more games

2) After my old account (spiritwolf10) got hacked. im not in the mood for MC anymore. the only time i play mc is when i decide to play a modpack.

3) Its Minecraft Period. I know they are working on 1.8 but until then i will only be playing Modpacks.

4) My family says im playing it too much and i agree. im not going to play minecraft because my brother is going off to college so im going to hang out with him.

I Would like to thank these people that made me feel welcomed in Avicus:

PeachyYas 

99250

kammy878

Slicorn

Evocal
There are probally a few more people but if i forgot you im sorry.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               This is Goodbye!
